clips.title: The story
paras: Josef Gregorian is a Forsaken tailoring trainer found working in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity. He guides ambitious Horde tailors seeking to weave enchanted fabrics, providing expertise and directing them toward specialized garments.

Amid the dim alchemical lanterns and damp vaults of the Magic Quarter, Josef Gregorian maintains the fine craft of tailoring for the Forsaken and their Horde allies. While life in the subterranean kingdom has turned cold, cloth-working remains vital for warlocks, mages, and priests who channel raw energies through woven fibers. Gregorian serves as a dependable instructor in the capital, ready to teach foundational patterns and to stitch the first robes of young mages who bring him the right materials.
